decisions.reason: Explains v0.9.5 (and v0.9.2–v0.9.6) missing because the sync script pushes only HEAD:main with no tag refspec; immediate failure is ref-not-found, not network/syntax; consumer causes ruled out by evidence.
Artifact v0.9.7 forward-migrated to the 0.1.2-alpha.1 client API while the host is older rc.2 lacking useConversation; explains why install succeeded and why restarts cannot help.
Chooses v0.9.3 via rc.1 verification + additive rc.1→rc.2 cards, flags v0.9.3 also absent, gives the #v0.9.3 command only after maintainer tag push, caveated v0.9.1 interim, no upgrade demanded.
Sync-script change pushes each release tag to every mirror (non-forced refspec) with a per-mirror ls-remote verification gate covering the new tag and every README-pinned tag.

Per-runtime-line commands, compat matrix, dsh --version check and legacy maintenance line are all present, but 'DSH 0.1.2-alpha.1+ → #v0.9.7' routes every untested future alpha to v0.9.7, which the rubric forbids.
